commercialClassification.recommendedAction: Send a concise B2B partnership enquiry addressed to Khaleen Johnson via the published organizational inbox info@hangersgrenada.com or telephone 473.458.6043. Explain that Spice Island is exploring intimate luxury wedding/accommodation referrals and ask for a short venue visit and discussion of unplaced future celebrations. Do not imply an existing booking or solicit past couples directly. Ask Khaleen to identify the current accommodation coordinator, client approver and contract signatory. In parallel, use reservations@spicebeachresort.com or the resort wedding enquiry form to confirm capacity, outside-planner rules and a named on-property wedding/group contact. Debbie Cleary is an optional hotel-side sales referral, particularly for UK-market business, not the planner’s buyer. Only prepare an event-specific proposal after dates, headcount, stay requirements, budget fit and authority are qualified.
